inclusions_summary: Core HIPAA portal development, infrastructure security audits, out-of-hours compliance patching
exclusions_summary: Routine maintenance covered under base infrastructure retainer

clauses.title: Core Scoped Portal Deliverables
clauses.text: Development and engineering of the core HIPAA patient management portal, telemedicine integrations, and FHIR API endpoints shall be billed on a Time & Materials basis at the standard engineering rate ($200/hr).

clauses.title: Out-of-Hours Security Remediation & HIPAA Compliance
clauses.text: Out-of-hours security remediation, vulnerability mitigation, and urgent HIPAA compliance patching requested by Client shall be billable at standard specialist T&M rate ($240/hr).

clauses.title: Base Maintenance Retainer Exclusion
clauses.text: Routine monthly operational server patching during scheduled business hours is included within base infrastructure retainer and is not billable as ad-hoc T&M.

inclusions_summary: FIX 4.4 protocol gateways, low-latency market data framing, exchange connectivity spikes
exclusions_summary: Unapproved exploratory prototyping or speculative research without VP sign-off

clauses.title: Core FIX 4.4 Engine Implementation
clauses.text: Architecture, coding, and integration of FIX 4.4 trading gateway order routing engine billed at standard developer hourly rate ($200/hr).

clauses.title: Ad-hoc Protocol Spikes & Benchmarking
clauses.text: Ad-hoc interface spikes, non-standard protocol benchmarking, and experimental technical evaluations requested outside sprint commitments shall be billed on a Time & Materials basis at the engineer's standard hourly rate ($200/hr).

clauses.title: Unapproved Exploratory Research Exclusion
clauses.text: Exploratory prototyping or speculative research conducted without written confirmation or ticket sign-off from Client VP of Engineering is non-billable.

inclusions_summary: Architecture advisory, technical executive roadmapping, custom inventory connectors

clauses.title: Enterprise Architecture & Strategic Advisory
clauses.text: Enterprise architecture advisory sessions, technical executive alignment workshops, and roadmap consulting shall be billed at respective senior staff T&M rates ($250/hr for Principal Architect, $175/hr for Technical Account Manager).

clauses.title: Custom ERP & Inventory Connectors
clauses.text: Engineering of real-time inventory webhooks and custom omnichannel connectors billed at standard backend T&M rate ($200/hr).

clauses.title: 30-Day Defect Warranty Exclusion
clauses.text: Remediation of defects or bugs reported within 30 days of release acceptance shall be executed at Agency's sole expense and is non-billable.

inclusions_summary: Custom third-party API webhooks, bespoke CRM payload transformers, flow automation

clauses.title: Core Workflow Engine Integration
clauses.text: Development of workflow engines, execution DAGs, and state management services at standard hourly rate ($195/hr).

clauses.title: Custom Third-Party API Webhooks & CRM Transformers
clauses.text: Custom third-party API webhooks, bespoke CRM payload transformers, and endpoint integrations falling outside the standard baseline connector set are billable at standard backend T&M rate ($200/hr).

clauses.title: Informal Micro-Sessions Exclusion
clauses.text: Informal communications, operational check-ins, or staff guidance sessions of fifteen (15) minutes or less duration shall not be billed.

inclusions_summary: Multi-region Kubernetes, scheduled weekend disaster recovery simulations, Terraform CI/CD
exclusions_summary: Internal Meridian training and platform onboarding

clauses.title: Production Multi-Cloud Infrastructure
clauses.text: Terraform provisioning, Kubernetes cluster orchestration, and service mesh management billed at DevOps specialist rate ($225/hr).

clauses.title: Scheduled Weekend Infrastructure Drills & DR Simulations
clauses.text: Scheduled weekend infrastructure drills, disaster recovery simulations, and maintenance windows are billable at the DevOps specialist rate ($225/hr), subject to a 2-hour minimum callout.

clauses.title: Internal Training & Onboarding Exclusion
clauses.text: Meridian internal staff training, platform onboarding, or tooling setup is non-billable to Client.
